stem: A woman of childbearing age with severe psoriasis is being considered for systemic therapy. She plans to conceive in the near future. Which of the following medications is contraindicated due to teratogenicity?
keywords: Woman of childbearing age – Indicates pregnancy considerations and teratogenic risk.
Systemic therapy – Narrows focus to drugs affecting the whole body, not topical/local treatments.
Contraindicated / teratogenicity – Directly points to drugs that can cause fetal malformations.

C.title: Acitretin
C.body:
Acitretin is a second-generation systemic retinoid primarily used for severe or recalcitrant psoriasis. While highly effective, it is strictly contraindicated in women who are pregnant or planning to become pregnant due to its extreme teratogenicity (ability to cause severe birth defects).
Highly teratogenic retinoid. Even after discontinuation, pregnancy must be avoided for at least 3 years due to its long half-life and risk of severe congenital malformations (craniofacial, cardiac, CNS).
Not safe in women of childbearing age planning conception.
C.systemInvolved: Dermatologic (skin), teratogenic effects on multiple fetal organ systems (CNS, heart, craniofacial).

A.title: Methotrexate
A.body:
Methotrexate is a folate antagonist and highly teratogenic, causing fetal malformations and miscarriage.
It is contraindicated in pregnancy and women planning conception, but its teratogenicity can be reversed after discontinuation for an adequate washout period (usually 3–6 months).
A.systemInvolved: Hematologic / immune system (also affects rapidly dividing cells).

B.title: Cyclosporine
B.body:
Immunosuppressant that inhibits T-cell activation.
Generally considered relatively safer in women planning pregnancy if used with caution, though monitoring for maternal hypertension and renal effects is needed.

D.title: Narrow-band UVB
D.body:
Phototherapy is safe in pregnancy.
Used as a systemic-sparing treatment for severe psoriasis when systemic drugs are contraindicated.

E.title: Topical steroids
E.body:
Safe for short-term or moderate use during pregnancy.
May cause systemic absorption in very high-potency or large-area use, but generally low risk.

keyConcept: Acitretin is a systemic retinoid and absolute contraindication in women planning pregnancy due to long-lasting teratogenicity. Safe systemic alternatives for childbearing women include cyclosporine and narrow-band UVB, while topical steroids are generally safe.

diagram.name: Systemic Therapy of Psoriasis – Drug Safety in Women of Childbearing Age Systemic Therapy of Psoriasis
diagram.caption: This diagram illustrates the safety profile of systemic and topical treatments for severe psoriasis in women planning pregnancy. It highlights highly teratogenic drugs (Acitretin, Methotrexate) to avoid, relatively safe options (Cyclosporine, Narrowband UVB), and generally safe topical steroids, emphasizing clinical decision-making for pregnancy planning. The central figure of a pregnant woman reinforces the focus on reproductive safety.
